en.summary: Mixed writeback-cache enablement commit with real correctness fixes. The clearest injectable repair is the bank hazard logic now comparing the physical SRAM line index, not the full line address, when suppressing read-after-write hazards.
why_it_counts: The chosen primary fix is in the cache bank hazard path, which is core DUT logic.
The patch comment explicitly says the tag and data stores need protection against BRAM read-after-write hazards.
The diff also tightens downstream gating and selected-victim dirty bookkeeping, reinforcing that the bug was a real cache-correctness issue.
disqualifiers: The commit also flips cache writeback defaults on in hw/rtl/VX_config.vh, which is configuration noise rather than the portable bug fix.
Several related cache fixes are bundled together, so the injection plan focuses on the narrowest clearly grounded mechanism.
evidence: In hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bank.sv, rdw_hazard3_st1 changes from comparing addr_st0 == addr_st1 to comparing line_sel_st0 == line_sel_st1.
The same file additionally gates mreq_queue_push with ~rdw_hazard3_st1, extending the hazard protection to memory-request issuance.

VX_cache_data.sv changes dirty-byte storage to operate per line/per way, and VX_cache_tags.sv narrows evict_dirty to the selected evict way, showing the commit addresses real writeback-cache correctness rather than style.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: BRAM or SRAM hazards are determined by the physical memory index being accessed, not by the full cache tag+index address. In a set-associative cache, different tags that map to the same set still collide in the same RAM row. If hazard logic compares full addresses instead of the physical line index, same-set accesses can bypass the stall and read stale or partially updated data.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Back-to-back cache operations touch different tags in the same set while a write, fill, or eviction is still active in the tag/data RAM.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Stall only on exact full-address matches instead of on physical line-index matches.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: compare tag+index rather than RAM index for hazard detection
portability_notes: This applies to any cache whose RAMs are indexed by set/line index while tags are stored separately or folded into the same row.
The bug is especially likely in designs that pipeline cache operations across one or more SRAM cycles.
A secondary reinforcing mutation is to omit hazard gating on downstream request enqueue once the hazard predicate is weakened.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that suppresses reads or downstream issue after a cache write, fill, or eviction to avoid SRAM read-during-write hazards.
Identify the compare that should use the physical RAM row index or set index.
Replace that compare with a stricter full-address compare so accesses to different tags in the same set are no longer treated as hazards.
If the design also gates downstream enqueue on that hazard, remove or weaken that gate as well.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Cache-bank read-after-write hazard detection and selected-victim dirty bookkeeping
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix compares line_sel rather than full addr for rdw_hazard3, blocks mreq_queue_push during that hazard, and corrects associated per-way dirty bookkeeping in data/tags.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change rdw_hazard3_st1 back to compare full addresses instead of line_sel, and optionally drop the ~rdw_hazard3_st1 guard on mreq_queue_push.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Same-set accesses after a write can observe stale or partially updated cache state, or trigger incorrect writeback/memory-request behavior, leading to intermittent cache corruption.
evidence_for_injection: The source comment in VX_cache_bank.sv explicitly explains that the hazard is about BRAM read-after-write protection.
The compare changed exactly in the way expected for a set-index versus full-address bug.
Additional dirty-byte and evict_dirty fixes in the same commit support the interpretation that writeback mode was exposing real cache state bugs.
notes: The configuration toggles in VX_config.vh are not part of the recommended reinjection.
This entry keeps the commit as dut_bugfix even though it also contains enablement/configuration noise.

zh.summary: 这是一个把 writeback 模式默认打开的混合提交，同时也包含真实的正确性修复。其中最适合注入的修复点是：bank hazard 逻辑现在按物理 SRAM 行索引比较，而不是按完整 line address 比较，以此抑制读后写冲突。
why_it_counts: 选定的主修复位于 cache bank hazard 路径，是核心 DUT 逻辑。
补丁注释明确说明 tag/data 存储需要防止 BRAM 的 read-after-write hazard。
diff 还同步收紧了下游门控和选中 victim 的 dirty 账本，进一步证明这是实际的 cache 正确性问题。
disqualifiers: 该提交还在 hw/rtl/VX_config.vh 中把 cache writeback 默认值打开，这属于配置噪声，不是可移植的主缺陷。
提交打包了多个相关 cache 修复，因此注入方案只聚焦于证据最清楚、最小的那个机制。
evidence: 在 hw/rtl/cache/VX_cache_bank.sv 中，rdw_hazard3_st1 的比较条件从 addr_st0 == addr_st1 改成了 line_sel_st0 == line_sel_st1。
同一文件还给 mreq_queue_push 增加了 ~rdw_hazard3_st1 门控，把 hazard 保护延伸到了 memory request 发射。
VX_cache_data.sv 把 dirty-byte 存储改成按 line/per-way 维护，VX_cache_tags.sv 也把 evict_dirty 收紧为只看被选中的 evict way，说明该提交修复的是实际 writeback cache 正确性问题，而不是代码风格。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: BRAM 或 SRAM hazard 取决于访问的物理存储索引，而不是完整的 cache tag+index 地址。在组相联 cache 中，不同 tag 只要映射到同一个 set，就会落到同一个 RAM 行。如果 hazard 逻辑按完整地址比较而不是按物理 line index 比较，那么同 set 访问就可能绕过停顿，读到陈旧或部分更新的数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 同 set 读后写 hazard 抑制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 相邻两个 cache 操作访问的是同一个 set 中不同 tag 的 line，而前一个写、fill 或 eviction 仍在 tag/data RAM 中进行。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 只在完整地址完全相等时才停顿，而不是在物理 line index 相等时停顿。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 用 tag+index 而不是 RAM index 来做 hazard 比较
portability_notes: 适用于任何 RAM 以 set/line index 为索引，而 tag 单独存储或折叠进同一行的 cache。
在跨一个或多个 SRAM 周期进行流水处理的 cache 中，这类问题尤其常见。
如果设计还会根据该 hazard 门控下游请求入队，也可以同步去掉这层门控以增强故障。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在 cache 写、fill 或 eviction 后，为避免 SRAM read-during-write hazard 而抑制读或下游发射的逻辑。
定位其中本应按物理 RAM 行索引或 set 索引比较的条件。
把该比较替换成更严格的完整地址比较，使“同 set 但不同 tag”的访问不再被视为 hazard。
如果设计还用该 hazard 门控下游入队，也一并删除或弱化这层门控。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache bank 中的读后写 hazard 检测，以及选中 victim 的 dirty 账本
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 rdw_hazard3 的比较对象从完整地址改成 line_sel，并在该 hazard 期间阻止 mreq_queue_push，同时修正了 data/tag 侧按 way 的 dirty 账本。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 rdw_hazard3_st1 改回比较完整地址而不是 line_sel；如需增强复现，也可去掉 mreq_queue_push 上的 ~rdw_hazard3_st1 门控。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 写之后的同 set 访问会看到陈旧或部分更新的 cache 状态，或者触发错误的写回/内存请求行为，最终导致间歇性 cache 损坏。
evidence_for_injection: VX_cache_bank.sv 中的源注释已经明确说明该 hazard 与 BRAM 的 read-after-write 保护有关。
比较条件的修改方式正好符合“set 索引与完整地址混淆”的 bug 模式。
同一提交还修复了 dirty-byte 和 evict_dirty 相关问题，说明 writeback 模式确实暴露了真实 cache 状态错误。
notes: VX_config.vh 中的配置切换不属于建议的 reinjection 范围。
尽管该提交包含 enablement/configuration 噪声，这里仍保留其为 dut_bugfix。
